text:
Avery (SRE): Noticed uptick in customer tickets about degraded text quality for hosted /v1/generate starting ~15:20 UTC. Error rates are low but complaint volume high — outputs are shorter and missing context.

OpsBot: [ALERT] Quality regressions detected by regression-monitor (evals-service). Auto-incident INC-2025-012 created and oncall paged.

Lena (Prod Eng): Looking at routing logs 15:18 UTC we began routing a subset of traffic to model-quantized-v2 as part of cost-saving fallback policy when capacity hit soft-threshold. That model is ~4x cheaper but lower-context retention.

Sam (MLOps): Confirmed. Canary rollout for quantized variants started at 15:00 UTC to save burst capacity. Policy mis-scoped and included requests for customers in PLG tier; should have been limited to internal traffic.

Marta (Customer Success): Support queue: several PLG customers report truncated completions and missing instructions in assistant responses. Some flagged potential compliance-sensitive omissions. They're asking for ETA.

Avery (SRE): Immediate mitigation: reverted routing-policy and pinned PLG customers back to model-cached-v1. Executed commands:
```
# revert routing-policy
kubectl -n routing apply -f /configs/routing/pin-plg-to-v1.yaml
infractl roll-reload routing --scope=plg
```

Lena (Prod Eng): After revert we see restored output length and context in sampled requests within ~2 minutes. Monitoring shows customer complaint rate dropping.

Tobias (Research): We also observed a measurable drop in BLEU/ROUGE-like evals for the quantized variant on our prompt suite (median quality -12%). Not surprising given the aggressive quantization and reduced context windows.

Sam (MLOps): Rollback note: I rolled back the automatic fallback rule and disabled the cost-saving canary until we have stricter scoping. Changed config in feature-flag: "quantized_fallback_scope": "internal-only".

StatusPage Bot: Posted status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2025-012 1: Partial degradation for hosted generation 15:20-15:40 UTC. Affected: some PLG customers on burst routing.

Marta (Customer Success): Sent targeted customer message to impacted tenants explaining mitigation and linking to status page. CS asked for an internal summary for higher-touch customers.

Lena (Prod Eng): Current status: mitigated 15:40 UTC 1 diagnostics show normal output distribution and decreased complaint volume. We'll keep channel open during 1h observation window.

Sam (MLOps): Follow-ups: 1) postmortem with action items (Sam + Lena + Avery + Tobias), 2) add guardrail in routing engine to prevent canary from including PLG/paid customers, 3) add automated quality checks that block rollouts if eval delta > 5% on representative prompt set, 4) audit feature-flagging template to avoid ambiguous scopes.

Avery (SRE): Marking incident mitigated and entering monitoring window. If anyone sees reverts or fresh regressions, ping @oncall immediately. :white_check_mark:
